## Onboarding

Use with the onboarding issue to record completion; access requests and Security Officer approvals stay on that issue. Link restricted evidence rather than copying personal data or credentials into this PR. Mark inapplicable items with a reason. Do not merge until all required items are complete.

- Onboarding issue:
- Manager / checklist owner:
- Start date:

## Access and equipment

- [ ] Identity verification method recorded on the onboarding issue before account creation.
- [ ] Every required system and access level inventoried on the issue; Security Officer approval and actual access granted recorded, using least privilege.
- [ ] Company assets issued and recorded in the asset inventory with their owner.
- [ ] Workstation encryption, firewall, malware protection, automatic updates, screen lock and Drata agent configured and verified.
- [ ] 1Password provisioned; all work passwords stored there and nowhere written down.
- [ ] MFA enabled on every system that offers it; approved SSO and remote access configured.

## Security orientation and training

- [ ] Employee introduced to relevant environments, systems, security requirements, operating procedures and incident reporting to security@gradiated.com.
- [ ] Required policy acknowledgements recorded, including Information Security, Acceptable Use, Password Policy, Code of Conduct and role-specific policies.
- [ ] [Prohibited activities](https://github.com/Gradiated/gradiated/blob/main/docs/security/policies/acceptable-use-policy.md#prohibited-activities) reviewed; employee knows how changes and training will be communicated.
- [ ] Initial security awareness training completed within 30 days of start; completion date and restricted evidence reference recorded.
- [ ] Role-specific training completed, including secure coding training before writing or supporting custom software where applicable.
- [ ] Employee enrolled in annual security awareness training and annual policy acknowledgements; owner and next due date recorded.
- [ ] Manager verified completion within 30 days of start; acknowledgement and training evidence retained for audit in Drata or linked restricted records.
